types.description: Abstract base class for actuators (IFC: IfcActuator). Concrete subtypes: Valve, Damper, Dimmer, Motor.
Air handling unit - HVAC ventilation system (IFC: IfcUnitaryEquipment, VDI 3814)
Air terminal - VAV/CAV box, diffuser, grille (IFC: IfcAirTerminal / IfcAirTerminalBox).
Individually metered household appliance (washing machine, dryer, dishwasher, ...). Inherits energy-flow attributes from Meter; adds category + nameplate info.
Battery storage system (IFC: IfcElectricFlowStorageDevice)
Heating boiler (IFC: IfcBoiler, VDI 3814)
Building (IFC: IfcBuilding)
Abstract base class for building elements (IFC: IfcBuildingElement)
Building storey/floor (IFC: IfcBuildingStorey)
CO2 concentration sensor (IFC: IfcSensor/CO2SENSOR). Unit: ppm.
EV charging station / wallbox. Inherits energy-flow attributes from Meter; adds connector type, session telemetry.
Chilled beam terminal (IFC: IfcCooledBeam). Passive or active cooling beam; some installations also support heating - set IsReversible=true in that case.
Cooling chiller (IFC: IfcChiller, VDI 3814)
Damper actuator (IFC: IfcDamper).
Lighting dimmer / electronic ballast (IFC: IfcActuator/ELECTRICACTUATOR). Standalone dimmer entity; for building-element luminaires use Luminaire.DimmingLevel directly.
Logical grouping of equipment that belong to one distribution system - heating circuit, cooling circuit, ventilation system, electrical circuit, etc. (IFC: IfcDistributionSystem).
Door with state attributes (IFC: IfcDoor)
Electric room heater - convector, IR panel, towel rail (IFC: IfcSpaceHeater/CONVECTOR with ELECTRIC USERDEFINED).
External spatial element - terrace, balcony, garden, driveway (IFC: IfcExternalSpatialElement). Distinct from Space - typically no indoor sensors, no thermal/lighting requirements.
Fan coil unit (IFC: IfcUnitaryEquipment + IfcFan). Forced-air + hydronic coil(s); 2-pipe uses one valve + IsReversible, 4-pipe has separate heating and cooling valves.
Fallback sensor type for proprietary / vendor-specific or unclassified measurements. CurrentValue is String to carry any payload (numeric, enum, custom).

Grid coupling point — the formal point where the installation meets the public utility grid. Carries Direction (Import/Export/Bidirectional) plus optionally an association to a Basic.Energy/MeteringPoint for formal Zählpunkt linkage.
Heat pump (IFC: IfcUnitaryEquipment/HEATPUMP, VDI 3814). Reversible aggregate capable of heating, active cooling and/or passive cooling depending on capabilities.
Relative humidity sensor (IFC: IfcSensor/HUMIDITYSENSOR). Unit: %RH.
Abstract water-based room terminal. Concrete subtypes: Radiator, RadiantSurface, ChilledBeam, FanCoilUnit.
Illuminance / light level sensor (IFC: IfcSensor/LIGHTSENSOR). Unit: lux.
Inverter - converts DC to AC power (IFC: IfcUnitaryEquipment)
Light fixture (IFC: IfcLightFixture, VDI 3814)

Energy/utility meter (electricity, gas, heat, water). Concrete — use directly for generic sub-meters (e.g. per-floor electricity meters fed via Loxone), or extend via GridConnection / ChargingStation / Appliance for shape-specific semantics. For Loxone-fed meters, MeterIdentifier holds the Loxone control reference.
Motor / variable-speed drive (IFC: IfcMotorConnection / IfcActuator). Use for shading drives, pump VSDs, fan motors.
PV string - group of connected PV modules (IFC: IfcSolarDevice)

Abstract base for passive building/fabric elements that are located in a space but not actively controlled as a device (Wall, Door, Window, Luminaire, ShadingDevice). Separating these from Sensor/Actuator/RoomTerminal lets the Space.SpaceElements association target only fabric elements, removing the overlap with SpaceSensors/SpaceActuators/SpaceTerminals.

Photovoltaic system - logical grouping of PV strings, inverters and battery (IFC: IfcSystem). A pure logical aggregate (NamedEntity, NOT a spatial TreeNode): it lives in the Systems view only. Its physical components (PVString/Inverter/BatteryStorage) are anchored in the spatial tree where they actually sit (roofs, Technikraum) and are grouped here via the outbound SystemMembers association. The PhotovoltaicSystem is itself a member of the electrical DistributionSystem via inbound MemberOfSystem (nested IfcSystem).
Occupancy / presence sensor / PIR (IFC: IfcSensor/MOVEMENTSENSOR). Boolean.
Pump (IFC: IfcPump, VDI 3814)
Radiant surface terminal - underfloor, ceiling or wall (IFC: IfcSpaceHeater/RADIATOR USERDEFINED). Can be reversible (heating + passive cooling) when IsReversible=true.
Conventional water-based radiator (IFC: IfcSpaceHeater/RADIATOR). Single heating valve.
Abstract base class for room-level terminal units (VDI 3814: Raumterminal). Concrete subtypes are HydronicTerminal, AirTerminal, ElectricHeater.
Operational schedule (occupancy, heating, cooling, lighting, etc.) that can be shared across multiple spaces via M:N association. IFC analog: IfcWorkSchedule.
Abstract base class for sensors (IFC: IfcSensor). Concrete subtypes carry a typed CurrentValue attribute.
Shading device - blind, shutter, awning (IFC: IfcShadingDevice, VDI 3814)
Site/location - root of spatial hierarchy (IFC: IfcSite)

Room - central object for energy optimization (IFC: IfcSpace + VDI 3814 Raumautomation). Sensors/Actuators/Terminals are modeled as separate entities and linked via SpaceSensors/SpaceActuators/SpaceTerminals.
Abstract base class for technical building systems (VDI 3814: Anlagenautomation)
Temperature sensor (IFC: IfcSensor/TEMPERATURESENSOR). Unit: °C.
Thermal energy storage / buffer tank (IFC: IfcTank/THERMALTANK). Stores heating or cooling energy for time-shift operation.
Valve actuator (IFC: IfcValve).
Wall element (IFC: IfcWall)
Window with state attributes (IFC: IfcWindow)
Window / door contact sensor (IFC: IfcSensor/CONTACTSENSOR). Boolean (true = closed/normal, false = open/triggered).

associationRoles.description: Actuators physically attached to a plant equipment item (e.g. heat pump changeover valve, pump VSD)
Sensors physically attached to a plant equipment item (e.g. boiler supply temperature sensor, AHU filter pressure sensor)
Optional link from an EnergyIQ Meter (typically GridConnection) to a formal Basic.Energy/MeteringPoint carrying the Zählpunktnummer (Austrian/German grid identifier) and EDA state.
Actuators physically located in this space (room-level valves, dampers, dimmers not attached to a specific terminal/equipment)
Schedules applied to spaces (M:N - one schedule can cover many rooms, one room can have multiple schedules)
Sensors physically located in this space (room thermostats, CO2 sensors, presence sensors, etc.)
Room terminals (Radiator, RadiantSurface, FanCoilUnit, AirTerminal, etc.) located in this space

Floor-level spatial containment: a BuildingElement (e.g. a per-storey sub-meter that measures a whole floor) contained directly in a BuildingStorey rather than in a single Space. Storey-level counterpart of SpaceElements (IFC IfcRelContainedInSpatialStructure at the IfcBuildingStorey level). Use for equipment that serves an entire floor instead of one room.

Members of a logical DistributionSystem (e.g. heat pump, buffer tank, distribution pumps, all radiant surfaces belonging to one heating circuit). N:N — a reversible aggregate can belong to both a heating and a cooling circuit.

IfcRelServicesBuildings — the spatial structure (Space / BuildingStorey) a DistributionSystem serves. N:N: a storey is served by several systems (heating, passive cooling, ventilation), and a system serves several storeys/spaces.
Actuators attached to a room terminal (e.g. radiator thermostat valve, FCU coil valves, VAV damper actuator)
Plant-equipment that supplies energy/medium to a terminal (e.g. heat pump or AHU serving multiple terminals)
